# Glommer

> Glommer is a self-hosted social publishing platform with public posts, media,
> threaded replies, friends, messaging, and ActivityPub federation with the
> Fediverse.

Each installation is an independently operated community. Its About page,
Terms of Service, and Privacy Policy describe that community. Features such as
translation, relays, and external sign-in depend on the operator's configuration.

Published posts and attached media are public. Posts and replies are written by
members; attribute their statements to the author and link to the original post.
Replies belong to their parent discussion and are removed when it is deleted.
Help articles explain the software; member posts express their authors' views.

Links beginning with / refer to this installation. Use the public RSS feeds for
feed reading and NodeInfo for software discovery. The /api/ routes support the
browser application and are excluded from crawling by robots.txt. Federation
uses ActivityPub and WebFinger; it does not imply Mastodon client API support.

The software uses PHP, MySQL or MariaDB, and plain JavaScript modules. The
repository documentation covers installation, upgrades, background services,
backups, and development. A running installation may use an older version than
the repository; its About page and NodeInfo identify the installed version.

## This community

- [About](/about): Operator-provided community description and installed software version.
- [Help](/help/): Public user guide and help search.
- [Terms of Service](/terms): This community's terms.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): This community's privacy information.
- [Crawler directives](/robots.txt): Crawling rules for this installation.

## Using Glommer

- [Finding your way around](/help/finding-your-way-around): Navigation, feeds, and account features.
- [Composing a post](/help/composing-a-post): Publishing text, links, media, and polls.
- [Photos, video, and audio](/help/adding-photos-video-and-audio): Attaching media and waiting for processing.
- [Replies and threads](/help/replies-and-threads): Following a discussion and understanding reply context.
- [Content warnings](/help/content-warnings): Sensitive media covers and warnings for an entire post.
- [Following on the Fediverse](/help/following-on-the-fediverse): Following accounts across ActivityPub servers.
- [Encrypted messages](/help/encrypted-messages): Optional messaging encryption, passphrases, and its limits.
- [Reporting abuse](/help/reporting-abuse): Reporting content to the community's moderators.

## Public feeds and discovery

- [Main feed](/): Published local posts visible to visitors.
- [Site RSS feed](/feed.xml): Recent public local posts in RSS format.
- [RSS subscriptions](/feeds.opml): OPML discovery for the site's local member feeds.
- [Following with RSS](/help/following-with-rss): Site and individual profile feed addresses.
- [Tags](/tags/): Discover posts by hashtag.
- [Topics](/topics/): Discover trending subjects.
- [NodeInfo discovery](/.well-known/nodeinfo): Links to the installation's machine-readable software and usage information.

## Software documentation

- [Project README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/FedgeNo/glommer/master/README.md): Features, architecture, requirements, installation, operations, upgrades, and security behavior.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/FedgeNo/glommer): PHP and browser source, installer, and test suites.
